# Ray 2.57/2.58 can abort concurrent async actors on CPython 3.14 with
# "objects_valid ... Object at idx 0 was not stored":
# https://github.com/ray-project/ray/issues/66399
# Keep the full Linux 3.14 CI suite running until a fixed Ray release is verified.
# This is a CI-only workaround: older Ray has an async-actor memory leak on 3.14
# (https://github.com/ray-project/ray/issues/63290), so do not use this as a
# production dependency pin. Remove it after validating the upstream fix.
ray==2.56.0; python_version == "3.14" and sys_platform == "linux"
